group.name: sysexMessage
group.midi.doc: A System Exclusive message: F0 ... F7 around its members.

group.name: universalNonRealTime
group.midi.doc: The header of a universal non-real time message: F0 7E <device ID>.

field.name: UniversalId
field.midi.doc: Universal Non-Real Time (7E).

field.name: DeviceId
field.midi.doc: The device the message is for or from; 7F: all devices.

group.name: universalRealTime
group.midi.doc: The header of a universal real time message: F0 7F <device ID>.

field.name: UniversalId
field.midi.doc: Universal Real Time (7F).

field.name: DeviceId
field.midi.doc: The device the message is for or from; 7F: all devices.

field.name: lsb14
field.midi.doc: A 14-bit value in 2 bytes, least significant first.

field.name: lsb21
field.midi.doc: A 21-bit value in 3 bytes, least significant first.

field.name: lsb28
field.midi.doc: A 28-bit value in 4 bytes, least significant first.

field.name: lsb35
field.midi.doc: A 35-bit value in 5 bytes, least significant first.

field.name: msb14
field.midi.doc: A 14-bit value in 2 bytes, most significant first.

field.name: data
field.midi.doc: The rest of the message (up to F7, or up to the checksum).

dataTypeDef.name: countMinusOne
dataTypeDef.midi.doc: A count written as the count minus one (0 means 1).

group.name: IdentityRequest
group.midi.doc: Identity Request (7E 06 01): asks the device to identify itself; device ID 7F asks all devices.

group.name: IdentityReply
group.midi.doc: Identity Reply (7E 06 02): the identity of a device with a 1-byte manufacturer ID.

field.name: ManufacturerId
field.midi.doc: The 1-byte manufacturer ID (not 00).

field.name: FamilyCode
field.midi.doc: The device family code.

field.name: FamilyMember
field.midi.doc: The device family member (model) code.

field.name: SoftwareRevision
field.midi.doc: The software revision level (format by the manufacturer).

group.name: IdentityReplyExtendedId
group.midi.doc: Identity Reply (7E 06 02): the identity of a device with an extended (3-byte) manufacturer ID: 00 xx xx.

field.name: ExtendedId
field.midi.doc: The extended manufacturer ID prefix (00).

field.name: ManufacturerId
field.midi.doc: The 2 bytes of the extended manufacturer ID after the 00.

field.name: FamilyCode
field.midi.doc: The device family code.

field.name: FamilyMember
field.midi.doc: The device family member (model) code.

field.name: SoftwareRevision
field.midi.doc: The software revision level (format by the manufacturer).

group.name: MasterVolume
group.midi.doc: Master Volume (7F 04 01): the volume of the whole device.

field.name: Volume
field.midi.doc: 0 (off) to 16383 (maximum).

group.name: MasterBalance
group.midi.doc: Master Balance (7F 04 02): the left/right balance of the whole device.

field.name: Balance
field.midi.doc: 0 is hard left, 8192 center, 16383 hard right.

group.name: MasterFineTuning
group.midi.doc: Master Fine Tuning (7F 04 03): the tuning of the whole device in cents.

field.name: FineTuning
field.midi.doc: 8192 is A440; -100 to almost +100 cents.

group.name: MasterCoarseTuning
group.midi.doc: Master Coarse Tuning (7F 04 04): the tuning of the whole device in semitones.

field.name: Unused
field.midi.doc: The LSB: not used (00).

field.name: CoarseTuning
field.midi.doc: 64 (40H) is A440; -64 to +63 semitones.

group.name: GlobalParameterControl
group.midi.doc: Global Parameter Control (7F 04 05): sets global parameters of a slot (e.g. the GM2 reverb and chorus).

field.name: SlotPathLength
field.midi.doc: The number of slots in the slot path.

field.name: ParameterIdWidth
field.midi.doc: The number of bytes of a parameter ID.

field.name: ValueWidth
field.midi.doc: The number of bytes of a value.

repeat.name: SlotPath
repeat.midi.doc: The path to the slot: a pair of bytes per level.

repeat.name: Parameters
repeat.midi.doc: The parameter ID/value pairs, up to the end of the message.

group.name: EndOfFile
group.midi.doc: End of File (7E 7B): the transfer is complete.

group.name: Wait
group.midi.doc: Wait (7E 7C): the receiver is busy; the sender waits for an ACK.

group.name: Nak
group.midi.doc: NAK (7E 7E): the packet was not received correctly; send it again.

group.name: Ack
group.midi.doc: ACK (7E 7F): the packet was received correctly; send the next.
